title: Yasmine's Vote (stop motion)
format: cut-out paper stop motion, 12 poses per second

head: ELECTION DAY
MOROCCO · 23 SEPT 2026
scenes.note: Dramatization. Characters are fictional; events and figures are real.

lines.say: Yasmine is twenty-four. Engineering degree. No job. Today, Morocco votes.
lines.show: Yasmine is 24. Engineering degree. No job. Today, Morocco votes.

lines.say: A year ago, she marched with Gen Z two-one-two, for jobs, hospitals and schools.
lines.show: A year ago, she marched with Gen Z 212, for jobs, hospitals and schools.

lines.say: The King picks the head of government from the party with the most seats. So change the seats.

lines.say: He voted. She walked home. So did six in ten Moroccans.
